note: What a company wants and what a month without rations costs it (battles.md sections 2, 3, 8). Every figure here is tuning and section 12 says so: want-per-head for guns, tools and horses and each one's multiplier, and attrition per month while unsupported, are all on the list. Tools are a weapon here, not a toolbox - trenches dug, battlements thrown up, muskets kept firing - so they multiply effectiveness exactly as guns do, and a head wants fewer of them because they are shared.
